description: Connect a project subdomain to Feedback Loop
variableDescription: Apply with domain set to the DNS zone and host empty. communityHost: validated non-empty community hostname relative to that zone; cname: exact CNAME target returned by Vercel; proof: complete server-generated feedbackloop-domain= ownership TXT value; verificationHost: Vercel verification TXT hostname relative to the same zone, without a trailing dot; verification: complete vc-domain-verify= value returned by Vercel. Signed requests only; multiInstance preserves other communities in the zone.
